title: Practice: a review job that runs Claude Code in CI and gates on its JSON (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a valid run posts the findings above the floor and outside the disabled categories
cases.says: A valid run produces the comments above the floor and outside the disabled categories

cases.id: e1 a failed run fails the job instead of passing it silently
cases.says: A failed run (non-zero status, not JSON, turn limit, no output) fails the job and says why

cases.id: e2 an answer that breaks the schema fails the job and names the path of the problem
cases.says: An answer that breaks the schema fails the job and names the path of the problem

cases.id: e3 a finding at the failing severity blocks the merge and lower ones only comment
cases.says: A finding at a failing severity blocks, and lower ones only comment

cases.id: e4 the prompt lists earlier findings and existing tests and asks for new or unaddressed issues only
cases.says: The prompt lists earlier findings and existing tests, asks for new or unaddressed issues only, and ends with the diff

cases.id: e5 the schema file is valid draft 07 and requires every field of a finding
cases.says: The schema file is valid draft-07, requires every field of a finding and keeps enums closed

cases.id: e6 the workflow runs claude headless with json output a schema a turn limit read only tools and the context file
cases.says: The workflow runs Claude headless with JSON output, a schema, a turn limit, read-only tools and the context file, with a timeout and a secret key

cases.id: e7 the project file states what to report and what to skip with a severity example for each level
cases.says: The criteria file says what to report and skip, and gives a severity example at each level

cases.id: e8 no file holds a personal path an address or a key
cases.says: No file holds a personal path, an address or a key
